_comment: Which label of the fine-tuned region model means which registered value.
Read by the 'region_head' understander provider
(VISION_UNDERSTANDER_PROVIDER=region_head). The model reports labelled
regions inside a crop; for each attribute the crop is asked about, the
strongest mapped label near the crop's centre is the answer, and none at
all is 'not_visible' - the model did not find the part, so nothing is
claimed about it.
Every value must be in that attribute's registered domain
(config/policies/kitchen-safety.example.json). 'hairnet' is the model's
label for any head covering it was trained on, caps included - which is
also how kitchen-01's annotators counted a cap.
A region counts only at or above its floor: its label's entry in
label_min_scores, else min_score. VISION_REGION_HEAD_MIN_SCORE, when set,
replaces min_score (not the per-label floors).
min_score 0.3. kitchen-01, 41 human-labelled subjects, through the
production crops:
floor 0.40   head 87.8 %   hands 87.8 %
floor 0.30   head 90.2 %   hands 87.8 %
floor 0.25   head 90.2 %   hands 82.9 %  (gloves seen that were not there)
and at every floor no absent value answered where the truth was present
or not visible. On live cam-13 frames 0.3 took bare hands from 2 to 16
decided; 7 of 8 distinct crops were plainly bare hands.
face_mask / no_face_mask stay at 0.4. This CCTV looks down on people, and
at 0.3 about half of the 'no_face_mask' crops were heads bowed or turned
away - no face in view to judge. kitchen-01 has no face labels, so this
floor rests on that visual check, not on a measured rate.
